copyPanel.formula: Unit Price = Cost ÷ Quantity | Total Cost = Unit Price × Quantity
steps: 1. Find the unit rate by dividing total cost by quantity
2. Compare unit rates to determine the best deal
3. Multiply unit rate by desired quantity to calculate total cost

revealWordProblem.title: Apply: The Pizza Fundraiser
revealWordProblem.text: The 6th-grade class is buying pizza for a fundraiser. Pizza Palace sells 3 pizzas for $27.00, and Pizza Town sells 5 pizzas for $42.50. The class needs 15 pizzas. Find each pizzeria's unit rate (price per pizza), decide which one is the better buy, and figure out how much 15 pizzas will cost there. Show your work.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Pizza Palace: $27.00 ÷ 3 = $9.00 per pizza. Pizza Town: $42.50 ÷ 5 = $8.50 per pizza. Since $8.50 is the lower unit rate, the class should order from Pizza Town. 15 pizzas × $8.50 = $127.50.

questions.stem: Which is the better buy: 6 bouncy balls for $4.50 or 10 bouncy balls for $8.00?
choices: They cost the same per ball
choiceFeedback: Find the price per ball for each: divide cost by quantity.
Make sure you're dividing cost by quantity for each option.
hints: You can't compare $4.50 and $8.00 straight across — the packs hold different numbers of balls.
Find each pack's price for ONE ball (cost ÷ number of balls), then compare the two unit prices.
Start with the first deal: $4.50 ÷ 6. Then compute $8.00 ÷ 10 and see which per-ball price is lower.
questions.stemEs: ¿Cuál es la mejor compra: 6 pelotas saltarinas por $4.50 o 10 pelotas saltarinas por $8.00?
questions.explanationEs: $4.50 ÷ 6 = $0.75 cada una. $8.00 ÷ 10 = $0.80 cada una. $0.75 < $0.80, así que 6 por $4.50 es la mejor compra.
hintsEs: No puedes comparar $4.50 y $8.00 directamente: los paquetes traen cantidades distintas de pelotas.
Halla el precio de UNA pelota en cada paquete (costo ÷ número de pelotas) y luego compara los dos precios unitarios.
Empieza con la primera oferta: $4.50 ÷ 6. Luego calcula $8.00 ÷ 10 y ve qué precio por pelota es menor.

questions.stem: A faucet drips 15 ounces of water in 5 minutes. What is the unit rate?
choiceFeedback: You divided the minutes by the ounces. For ounces per minute, ounces go first.
hints: The unit rate here is ounces per ONE minute — 15 ounces spread across 5 minutes.
Divide the ounces by the minutes so the time becomes 1 minute.
Set up 15 ÷ 5 ounces per minute.
questions.stemEs: Una llave gotea 15 onzas de agua en 5 minutos. ¿Cuál es la tasa por unidad?
hintsEs: La tasa unitaria aquí son onzas por UN minuto: 15 onzas repartidas en 5 minutos.
Divide las onzas entre los minutos para que el tiempo se vuelva 1 minuto.
Plantea 15 ÷ 5 onzas por minuto.

questions.stem: A printer prints 42 pages in 6 minutes. How many pages does it print in 15 minutes at the same rate?
questions.explanation: Unit rate: 42 ÷ 6 = 7 pages per minute. In 15 minutes: 7 × 15 = 105 pages.
choiceFeedback: Not quite. Unit rate: 42 ÷ 6 = ___ pages per minute.
hints: This takes two steps: first find pages per ONE minute, then scale up to 15 minutes.
Divide to get the unit rate, then multiply that rate by the new time.
Step 1: 42 ÷ 6 = 7 pages each minute. Step 2: multiply that rate by 15 minutes.
questions.stemEs: Una impresora imprime 42 páginas en 6 minutos. ¿Cuántas páginas imprime en 15 minutos al mismo ritmo?
questions.explanationEs: Tasa por unidad: 42 ÷ 6 = 7 páginas por minuto. En 15 minutos: 7 × 15 = 105 páginas.
hintsEs: Esto toma dos pasos: halla primero las páginas por UN minuto y luego amplía a 15 minutos.
Divide para obtener la tasa unitaria, luego multiplica esa tasa por el tiempo nuevo.
Paso 1: 42 ÷ 6 = 7 páginas por minuto. Paso 2: multiplica esa tasa por 15 minutos.

reviewHighlights.formula: Unit Price = Cost ÷ Quantity | Total Cost = Unit Price × Quantity
steps: 1. Find the unit rate by dividing total cost by quantity
2. Compare unit rates to determine the best deal
3. Multiply unit rate by desired quantity to calculate total cost
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake in Solve Problems with Unit Rates is comparing the total prices instead of the cost per item — the deal with the smaller total can still cost more per unit. Always reduce each option to its unit rate before you decide, then pick the lower one.

level1.stem: 6 apples cost $3. What is the cost for 1 apple?
hints: Divide the price by the number of apples: $3 ÷ 6.
hintsEs: Divide el precio entre el número de manzanas: $3 ÷ 6.
level1.explanation: Divide the price by the number of apples: $3 ÷ 6 = $0.50 Write the unit price: $0.50 per apple
level1.explanationEs: Divide el precio entre el número de manzanas: $3 ÷ 6 = $0.50 Escribe el precio unitario: $0.50 por manzana

level1.stem: Shop A sells 2 pens for $3. Shop B sells 5 pens for $6. Which shop has the lower cost for 1 pen?
level1.stemEs: La tienda A vende 2 plumas por $3. La tienda B vende 5 plumas por $6. ¿Qué tienda tiene el costo más bajo por 1 pluma?
hints: Find the cost for 1 pen at each shop. Then compare.
hintsEs: Halla el costo de 1 pluma en cada tienda. Luego compara.
level1.explanation: Find the cost for 1 pen at each shop: $3 ÷ 2 = $1.50; $6 ÷ 5 = $1.20 Compare the unit prices: $1.20 < $1.50
level1.explanationEs: Halla el costo de 1 pluma en cada tienda: $3 ÷ 2 = $1.50; $6 ÷ 5 = $1.20 Compara los precios unitarios: $1.20 < $1.50

level1.stem: A pack of 10 tokens costs $2. What is the cost for 1 token?
level1.stemEs: Un paquete de 10 fichas cuesta $2. ¿Cuánto cuesta 1 ficha?
hints: Divide the price by the number of tokens: $2 ÷ 10.
hintsEs: Divide el precio entre el número de fichas: $2 ÷ 10.
level1.explanation: Divide the price by the number of tokens: $2 ÷ 10 = $0.20 Write the unit price: $0.20 per token
level1.explanationEs: Divide el precio entre el número de fichas: $2 ÷ 10 = $0.20 Escribe el precio unitario: $0.20 por ficha

level1.stem: 5 pens cost $4. What is the cost for 1 pen?
hints: Divide the price by the number of pens.
hintsEs: Divide el precio entre el número de plumas.
level1.explanation: Divide the price by the number of pens: $4 ÷ 5 = $0.80 Write the unit price: $0.80 per pen
level1.explanationEs: Divide el precio entre el número de plumas: $4 ÷ 5 = $0.80 Escribe el precio unitario: $0.80 por pluma

level1.stem: Game World sells 250 tokens for $35. What is the cost for 1 token?
level1.stemEs: Game World vende 250 fichas por $35. ¿Cuánto cuesta 1 ficha?
hints: Divide the price by the number of tokens: $35 ÷ 250.
hintsEs: Divide el precio entre el número de fichas: $35 ÷ 250.
level1.explanation: Divide the price by the number of tokens: $35 ÷ 250 = $0.14 Write the unit price: $0.14 per token
level1.explanationEs: Divide el precio entre el número de fichas: $35 ÷ 250 = $0.14 Escribe el precio unitario: $0.14 por ficha

level2.stem: Jada says 3 shirts for $24 is a better buy than 5 shirts for $35, because $24 is less. Is she right? What is the lower cost for 1 shirt?
level2.stemEs: Jada dice que 3 camisetas por $24 es mejor compra que 5 camisetas por $35, porque $24 es menos. ¿Tiene razón? ¿Cuál es el costo más bajo por 1 camiseta?
hints: Find the cost for 1 shirt in each deal before you compare.
hintsEs: Halla el costo de 1 camiseta en cada oferta antes de comparar.
level2.explanation: Find the cost for 1 shirt in each deal: $24 ÷ 3 = $8; $35 ÷ 5 = $7 Compare the unit prices: $7 < $8
level2.explanationEs: Halla el costo de 1 camiseta en cada oferta: $24 ÷ 3 = $8; $35 ÷ 5 = $7 Compara los precios unitarios: $7 < $8

level2.stem: A 15-pack of water bottles costs $4.50. What is the cost for 1 bottle?
level2.stemEs: Un paquete de 15 botellas de agua cuesta $4.50. ¿Cuánto cuesta 1 botella?
hints: Divide the price by the number of bottles.
hintsEs: Divide el precio entre el número de botellas.
level2.explanation: Divide the price by the number of bottles: $4.50 ÷ 15 = $0.30 Check with multiplication: 15 × $0.30 = $4.50
level2.explanationEs: Divide el precio entre el número de botellas: $4.50 ÷ 15 = $0.30 Comprueba con una multiplicación: 15 × $0.30 = $4.50

level2.stem: A pack of 8 markers costs $6. What is the cost for 1 marker?
level2.stemEs: Un paquete de 8 marcadores cuesta $6. ¿Cuánto cuesta 1 marcador?
hints: Divide the price by the number of markers.
hintsEs: Divide el precio entre el número de marcadores.
level2.explanation: Divide the price by the number of markers: $6 ÷ 8 = $0.75 Write the unit price: $0.75 per marker
level2.explanationEs: Divide el precio entre el número de marcadores: $6 ÷ 8 = $0.75 Escribe el precio unitario: $0.75 por marcador

level2.stem: Tokens cost $0.12 each at Fun Supply Co. How many tokens can you buy for $30?
level2.stemEs: Las fichas cuestan $0.12 cada una en Fun Supply Co. ¿Cuántas fichas puedes comprar con $30?
hints: Each token costs $0.12. How many groups of $0.12 are in $30?
hintsEs: Cada ficha cuesta $0.12. ¿Cuántos grupos de $0.12 hay en $30?
level2.explanation: Divide the money by the unit price: $30 ÷ $0.12 = 250 Check with multiplication: 250 × $0.12 = $30
level2.explanationEs: Divide el dinero entre el precio unitario: $30 ÷ $0.12 = 250 Comprueba con una multiplicación: 250 × $0.12 = $30

level2.stem: Car A goes 150 miles on 5 gallons of gas. Car B goes 168 miles on 6 gallons. Which car goes farther on 1 gallon?
level2.stemEs: El carro A recorre 150 millas con 5 galones de gasolina. El carro B recorre 168 millas con 6 galones. ¿Qué carro llega más lejos con 1 galón?
hints: Find the miles for 1 gallon for each car. Divide the miles by the gallons.
hintsEs: Halla las millas por 1 galón de cada carro. Divide las millas entre los galones.
level2.explanation: Find Car A's miles per gallon: 150 ÷ 5 = 30 Find Car B's miles per gallon: 168 ÷ 6 = 28 Compare the unit rates: 30 > 28
level2.explanationEs: Halla las millas por galón del carro A: 150 ÷ 5 = 30 Halla las millas por galón del carro B: 168 ÷ 6 = 28 Compara las tasas unitarias: 30 > 28

level3.stem: A store sells 8 notebooks for $20. At the same unit price, what is the cost of 14 notebooks?
choiceFeedback: That adds $1 for each of the 6 extra notebooks. Each notebook costs $2.50, so 6 more cost $15.
That adds the 8 notebooks to the $20. Find the price of ONE notebook first: 20 divided by 8.
That doubles the $20, which would buy 16 notebooks. Multiply the unit price by 14.

level3.stem: Tray A costs $12 and feeds 4 people. Tray B costs $21 and feeds 6 people. Tom says Tray B is the better deal because it feeds more people. What is the lower cost per person?
level3.stemEs: La bandeja A cuesta $12 y alcanza para 4 personas. La bandeja B cuesta $21 y alcanza para 6 personas. Tom dice que la bandeja B es mejor porque alcanza para más personas. ¿Cuál es el costo más bajo por persona?
hints: Find the cost for 1 person for each tray.
hintsEs: Halla el costo por 1 persona para cada bandeja.
level3.explanation: Find the cost per person for each tray: $12 ÷ 4 = $3; $21 ÷ 6 = $3.50 Compare the unit prices: $3 < $3.50
level3.explanationEs: Halla el costo por persona de cada bandeja: $12 ÷ 4 = $3; $21 ÷ 6 = $3.50 Compara los precios unitarios: $3 < $3.50

level3.stem: A 24-pack of batteries costs $15.60. What is the cost for 1 battery?
level3.stemEs: Un paquete de 24 pilas cuesta $15.60. ¿Cuánto cuesta 1 pila?
hints: Divide the price by the number of batteries.
hintsEs: Divide el precio entre el número de pilas.
level3.explanation: Divide the price by the number of batteries: $15.60 ÷ 24 = $0.65 Check with multiplication: 24 × $0.65 = $15.60
level3.explanationEs: Divide el precio entre el número de pilas: $15.60 ÷ 24 = $0.65 Comprueba con una multiplicación: 24 × $0.65 = $15.60

level3.stem: A printer prints 84 pages in 6 minutes. At this rate, how many pages does it print in 25 minutes?
level3.stemEs: Una impresora imprime 84 páginas en 6 minutos. A esta tasa, ¿cuántas páginas imprime en 25 minutos?
hints: Find the pages for 1 minute first.
hintsEs: Primero halla las páginas en 1 minuto.
level3.explanation: Find the unit rate: 84 ÷ 6 = 14 Multiply the unit rate by 25: 14 × 25 = 350
level3.explanationEs: Halla la tasa unitaria: 84 ÷ 6 = 14 Multiplica la tasa unitaria por 25: 14 × 25 = 350

level3.stem: Store A sells 6 cans for $4.20. Store B sells 8 cans for $5.44 but adds a $1 fee to each order. You need 48 cans in one order. Which store costs less in total?
level3.stemEs: La tienda A vende 6 latas por $4.20. La tienda B vende 8 latas por $5.44, pero cobra $1 extra por cada pedido. Necesitas 48 latas en un pedido. ¿Qué tienda cuesta menos en total?
hints: Store B has the lower unit price. Find both totals, and do not forget the fee.
hintsEs: La tienda B tiene el precio unitario más bajo. Halla los dos totales y no olvides el cargo extra.
level3.explanation: Find each unit price: $4.20 ÷ 6 = $0.70; $5.44 ÷ 8 = $0.68 Find each total for 48 cans: 48 × $0.70 = $33.60; 48 × $0.68 + $1 = $33.64 Compare the totals: $33.60 < $33.64
level3.explanationEs: Halla cada precio unitario: $4.20 ÷ 6 = $0.70; $5.44 ÷ 8 = $0.68 Halla cada total para 48 latas: 48 × $0.70 = $33.60; 48 × $0.68 + $1 = $33.64 Compara los totales: $33.60 < $33.64
